warnings: Axes: x = 1-3 (5.00 + 3.50); y = E, D, C, B, A printed top-to-bottom (2.70/2.30/3.50/1.50 = 10.00). Origin E1 (top-left).
The third column row has no printed bubble; it is named C here (assigned, flagged).

Only the two footing plans were swept: the floor-1 plan S-04 prints extra ticks (0.60 overhangs at both ends, 2.00 to a front beam, 0.60 / 1.07 stair ticks) that are not in this grid because that plan was not extracted.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget).
